## Highlights
### New
- Copy a tab's current link from its context menu without opening the tab - Preview any website at phone, desktop, or custom sizes from the Mac developer toolbar, available with Command-Shift-I - Select tabs, split views, and folders together on Mac to move and organize them in one step - Translate webpages on device, with automatic language detection, optional automatic translation, and a translation toolbar available with Command-Shift-L
### Improved
- Allow 120 FPS now starts off for smoother scrolling; turn it back on in Settings if you prefer higher frame rate page animations - Reduce background work when detecting videos for Picture in Picture
### Fixed
- Show pages reliably after a cold start or sidebar layout change on iPhone and iPad
---
